card.name: Neuroendocrine tumor drug label passages
card.fires_on: Blank or linking spots in labels for somatostatin analogs and carcinoid drugs. These include the gap before a section number like 5.1 and small words such as in, with, of, for before tumor or gastric terms.

modes.label: Gap before section number
modes.description: An empty marked spot just before a warnings cross-reference number in parentheses.

modes.label: Linking word in clinical sentence
modes.description: A small word like in, with, of or for inside sentences about gastric acid, diarrhea or tumor testing.

card.plain: It lights up on small joining words and gaps in labels for neuroendocrine tumor and somatostatin-type drugs.
